# OpenRailwayMap

Standard style and legend © 2024–2026 Hidde Wieringa and contributors.
Upstream: https://github.com/hiddewie/OpenRailwayMap-vector
License: GPL-3.0-or-later; see COPYING.

The TravelMap adapter selects the standard infrastructure preset, resolves
global parameters for MapLibre 5 compatibility, uses the existing map font,
prefixes layer/source IDs, and keeps railway tiles requested on demand.
No tile dataset is distributed here. Styles remain subject to the upstream license.

2026-10-16: refreshed style.json from upstream proxy/js/styles.mjs and its feature YAML inputs. Source Git blob SHA-1: fe2813c9a7ae85313c6421d34fac7bc033209bb3. Generated inputs are retained under output/railway-diagnosis for this local research run. Existing GPL-3.0-or-later licensing remains applicable.
